messages.author: 02e03030784aa6a7
messages.subject: Concatenation of vectors
parts:
It seems to me that two vectors x1 and x2 can be concatenated with the following code:

  x << x1,x2;

Is this the best way of doing it, and if so, should it be added to the documentation (in the file "matrix_arrays.cpp")?

Hans
---------------------

More context:

  vector<Type> x1(3);
  x1.fill(1);
  vector<Type> x2(5);
  x2.fill(2);
  vector<Type> x(8);
  x << x1,x2;

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] Concatenation of vectors
parts:
Yes, and I think it deserves to be documented. What may surprise users is that you need to declare the size of the result in advance.
